role_purpose.note: All 11 custom roles have at least one journey plus a grant or step. QM, Microbiology and Sustainability Reviewers have identical flow grants but are differentiated by step ownership. Admin and User are platform defaults with no journey (by design, A3). Case Admin's capability depends on REST (R-05).

incoherences.evidence: Start_Gate (Mandatory at OPNT_S0) checks 9 fields but not Query_Key (E; CIQP Query 'Query Key' required), Portal_Contact_Ids (E; -> Assigned_Contacts, required) or Awaiting_Response (E; Y3 approves only while = 'Yes', BR-047).
incoherences.effect: A supplier-facing point can be submitted without them: X3 creates no portal query, or Y3 never approves round 1. The point waits in 'Waiting for supplier' until the SLA breaches.
incoherences.fix: In the to-supplier branch of Start_Gate, also require Query_Key and Portal_Contact_Ids to be non-blank and Awaiting_Response = "Yes".

incoherences.evidence: CIQ_Section_A00.Portal_Contact_Ids is not required. X2 maps it to CIQP Section Assigned_Contacts, which is required (PART C). Every F3 row is a portal twin (v4 L280).
incoherences.effect: A section row without contacts creates no portal section, so the supplier never gets the section.

incoherences.evidence: automations[0].cross_container_contract X3 fires on 'enters OPNT_S1' with no OP_To_Supplier guard. PART D L883 says 'X3, only when OP_To_Supplier = "Yes"'. The connector step-entry trigger fires even for skipped steps (v4 L310). X5 carries its own guard; X3 does not.
incoherences.effect: Department review, Contact update and Internal review points would become supplier queries. That breaches BR-066 (never shared with the portal) and leaves phantom supplier tasks.
incoherences.fix: Add the guard 'only when OP_To_Supplier = "Yes"' to X3 and X3b in the contract handed to the portal session.

incoherences.evidence: CASE_S5's condition Hold_For_Open_Items reads Open_Items_Count and Open_CR_Count. These are writable only at CASE_S2 and CASE_S3, both before the fork, and nobody writes the case during Part 2 (C3, D15). CASE_S3 is normally approved by Y4, not by a person.
incoherences.effect: Any value written at S2/S3 is stale by construction. A 0 skips S5, so the following can pass to the PS-11 release request: RMM-owned points (the RMM lane is off by default), points raised after a lane signed off, contact updates and untriaged change requests. That violates BR-043 / REQ-PROC-036 natively, and only a Workbench convention protects it.
incoherences.fix: Recommended, deterministic: make Open_Items_Count and Open_CR_Count ReadOnly at CASE_S2 and CASE_S3. They are then blank at the join, S5 always runs once, and RMM writes fresh counts there (matches v4 L395 'hold steps run unconditionally'). The alternative is that Thomas fixes the Workbench rule in D15.

incoherences.evidence: After CASE_S3, Case_Contacts_JSON and Portal_Contact_Ids are ReadOnly at every step. Confirm_Contact_Ids and Supplier_Contact_Emails are writable only at S5, and the e-mails also at S8. A Contact update point (BR-033) has no step at which it can land fully.
incoherences.effect: If S5 is skipped, X5 (Assigned_Contacts <- Confirm_Contact_Ids) and Z1 (Supplier_Contact_Emails) go to the old contacts, and the case contact list stays stale.
incoherences.fix: Make Case_Contacts_JSON and Portal_Contact_Ids Editable at CASE_S5 (and S8), together with COH-04 so that S5 runs.

incoherences.evidence: v4 L257: a correction of a value RMM sets, e.g. the target markets. Target_Markets_Text is Editable only at CASE_S0 and S2, and Markets_Label only at S0.
incoherences.effect: An accepted correction after Scope check lives only in the CR's Proposed_Value_JSON and the new F4 run. The case header and the PDF stay stale.
incoherences.fix: Make Target_Markets_Text (and Markets_Label) Editable at CASE_S3 and CASE_S5.

incoherences.evidence: X6 -> CIQP Notice requires Notice Kind and the Case Code / Cycle No / Supplier Code header. At CHRQ_S1, Notice_Kind is only Editable. The header fields are writable only at CHRQ_S0, where nothing is Mandatory (D16).
incoherences.effect: A Y6 copy gap or a hand-made fallback CR can't be repaired at Triage. X6 then fails, and the supplier never gets the outcome.
incoherences.fix: At CHRQ_S1, make Notice_Kind Mandatory and Case_Code, Cycle_No and Supplier_Code Mandatory (or at least Editable).

incoherences.evidence: OP_Outcome is Mandatory at OPNT_R_* with list CIQ_OP_Outcome = Accepted, Returned, Withdrawn. A Return is meant to be the native send-back (BR-046). Open_Num = 1 unless the outcome is Accepted or Withdrawn.
incoherences.effect: Submitting 'Returned' ends the item with Open_Num = 1, no next round and no X3. The point stays unresolved and no step can reopen it.
incoherences.fix: Give OP_Outcome a two-value list (Accepted, Withdrawn) and keep 'Returned' for Rounds_Outcome only.

incoherences.evidence: CIQ_Case_A00.Final_PDF is the only process field that no step makes writable. Z1 rest_completion attaches it after End [unverified, K-15].
incoherences.effect: If K-15 fails, the final document has no home in the app. It is e-mailed only.
incoherences.fix: Record a fallback store in Z1 rest_completion, e.g. the PDF hash and file reference on the Z1 CIQ Audit Event row. Make K-15 an acceptance test.
incoherences.owner: kf-integration-analyst (+ kf-data-architect if a field is needed)

incoherences.evidence: Both open-items checks share Hold_Override_Reason. Open_Items_Gate returns 'OK' whenever it is non-blank.
incoherences.effect: An override written at S5 makes the gate at S8 pass without a new reason.
incoherences.fix: Have the Workbench clear Hold_Override_Reason on entering S8 (it is Editable there), or use a separate override per check.

risks.risk: Parallel blocks where every arm is skipped: every refused CR (all Impact_<D> = 'No'), and Part 2 with no active department. If the join does not advance, every refused CR hangs and X6 never sends the refusal.
Close hold after Y5 (open-questions Q8): when Y5 approves CASE_S7, nobody refreshes the counts, so items opened during S7 skip CASE_S8.
risks.owner: kf-integration-analyst / portal session (Y5 blanks the counts) or Thomas

risks.risk: Y1/Y3/Y4/Y5 'Approve an item' is unverified (Q6, A2 L58). The waiting steps stay RMM-owned, so the manual fallback keeps each journey satisfiable.

The post-generate reset for reviewers and the Overall Approver on CIQ Case is 'Permission [] or [View]'. [] would break security.satisfiability.readers and possibly the RMES Result_Case lookup. Choose [View].
Until flow Admin is granted over REST, CIQ Case Admin has no native capability. That covers cancelling during Part 2 or Overall approval, and ending stray P2/P3 items (j12).

The foundation contract at rev 8 has 9 open findings. Six are in automations (invalid-business-logic): five FOUNDATION_MAPPING_EXPRESSION, where `_id` (a Reference) is mapped into Text in Z1 Case_Item_Id/Object_Item_Id, Z3 Case_Item_Id/Object_Item_Id and Z4 Object_Item_Id; and one FOUNDATION_AUTOMATION_CONDITION, because the Z2 condition is an object, not an expression string. One is platform: FOUNDATION_ACTION_UNSUPPORTED, no adapter for 'notify' (Z2). Two are informational: FOUNDATION_INITIATOR_CONTRACT_MISMATCH (D18). They block accept-foundation, not journey semantics.
Runtime behaviour is unverified for: Mandatory formula gates on branches (K-20), `!=` on a blank Overall_Decision (K-PC), and branch-scoped permissions (K-OFF/K-PAR).

ratchet: RAT-1 ROLE_ACCESS_COLLAPSE: don't flag roles whose workflow assignee_role steps are disjoint.
RAT-2 never-writable field: warn on a non-formula Process field that is ReadOnly at every step and has no declared post-End writer (would catch Final_PDF).
RAT-3 stale hold: warn when a step condition reads fields whose last writable step is before an intervening parallel block.
RAT-4 handoff input: a field mapped into a required target field (cross_container_contract or automation field_map) must be Mandatory or gate-checked at the step whose entry fires the handoff.
content.verdict_note: Every in-scope journey (j01-j20) has a satisfiable end-to-end path with the committed steps, fields and grants. There are no orphan flows and no dead-end roles. Fix COH-01 to COH-04 before generate; COH-04 needs Thomas's D15 choice. COH-05 to COH-10 are bounded repairs. R-06 must be cleared by kf-integration-analyst for accept-foundation.
